project_meta.title: What If All Insects on Earth Vanished in Five Seconds?

global_style.art_style: Premium hand-drawn 2D editorial storybook cartoon illustration, polished animated short-film aesthetic, structured and consistent character anatomy, solid rounded torsos, two proportionate arms, two legs, clearly drawn hands and shoes, rounded heads, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes with no pupils, irises, highlights or eyelashes. Main character Aarav is a young Indian adult male with a warm-white rounded face, short neat black hair, mustard-yellow overshirt, cream T-shirt, dark navy trousers and white sneakers. Maintain identical face, body proportions, clothing and character design in every appearance. Rich attractive colors, confident dark ink outlines, detailed watercolor-and-ink environments, subtle paper texture, cinematic lighting, expressive poses, dynamic compositions, clear visual storytelling, professional animation quality, vertical 9:16 framing.
global_style.negative_prompt: No thin line figures, no wireframe people, no stick figures, no incomplete limbs, no missing hands or feet, no extra arms or legs, no inconsistent body proportions, no changing clothing, no changing face design, no realistic eyes, no pupils, no irises, no highlights, no eyelashes, no distorted anatomy, no malformed insects, no blurry images, no dull pale colors, no cluttered compositions, no visual glitches, no text, no captions, no labels, no logos, no watermarks.

Solid rounded torso, two proportionate arms, two legs, clearly drawn hands and shoes. Identical proportions and clothing in every scene.

beats.narration_text: सोचो, अगर अगले पाँच सेकंड में धरती के सारे कीड़े गायब हो जाएँ, तो क्या इंसान बच पाएगा?
beats.prompt_action: Extreme close-up of a golden-yellow honeybee hovering beside a vibrant purple flower in a lush garden. Its translucent wings are caught mid-flight, pollen grains glow in the sunlight, and the background is softly blurred. Create an immediate mysterious cinematic opening.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Establish the colorful garden and the honeybee's consistent golden-yellow body with dark stripes.

beats.narration_text: पहले तो लगेगा कि कुछ खास नहीं हुआ।
beats.prompt_action: Wide vertical view of a beautiful lively garden with flowers, butterflies, honeybees and green foliage. Aarav, a young Indian man with a warm-white rounded face, exactly two tiny black dot eyes, short neat black hair, mustard-yellow overshirt, cream T-shirt, navy trousers and white sneakers, stands peacefully among the flowers.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Introduce Aarav with his fixed clothing, face design and complete structured cartoon anatomy.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन एक... दो... तीन... और पाँच सेकंड में सब गायब!
beats.prompt_action: Dynamic close tracking composition showing a honeybee, an orange-and-black butterfly and a red ladybug suddenly disappearing in a sequence of tiny fading golden particles. Their flowers and leaves remain completely intact. Aarav watches in shock in the background.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the hypothetical disappearance of insects while keeping plants, people and the environment unchanged.

beats.narration_text: बगीचा अचानक शांत हो गया। न भिनभिनाहट, न तितलियाँ।
beats.prompt_action: High-angle view of the same garden, now completely empty of insects. Flowers still bloom, leaves move gently in the breeze, and Aarav stands alone looking around. The silence is conveyed through stillness and a slightly cooler cinematic atmosphere.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The hypothetical world now contains no insects. Keep the garden and Aarav visually consistent.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन असली मुसीबत तो अब शुरू होने वाली थी।
beats.prompt_action: Close-up of Aarav's worried face with exactly two tiny black dot eyes, one hand raised thoughtfully near his chin. Behind him, the empty flowers and silent garden are visible in soft focus. Dramatic sunlight creates a sense of an approaching problem.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Maintain Aarav's exact face, hairstyle and mustard-yellow overshirt.

beats.narration_text: क्योंकि बहुत सारे पौधों को फल बनाने के लिए कीड़ों की मदद चाहिए।
beats.prompt_action: Detailed macro illustration of a flowering plant with bright yellow pollen grains on its central structures, delicate petals and fresh green leaves. The frame emphasizes the tiny reproductive details of the flower without showing any insects.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Continue the insect-free hypothetical world and introduce the pollination problem.

beats.narration_text: मधुमक्खियाँ और तितलियाँ एक फूल से दूसरे फूल तक पराग पहुँचाती हैं।
beats.prompt_action: Educational visual showing two flowering plants in a rich garden, one with pollen grains and another ready to receive them. A soft golden dotted trail visually illustrates the usual movement of pollen between flowers, with no insects present. Keep the illustration natural and cinematic.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Illustrate the pollination process visually without bringing insects back into the hypothetical timeline.

beats.narration_text: उनके बिना कई फूलों का फल बनना मुश्किल हो जाएगा।
beats.prompt_action: Close-up of a flowering fruit tree branch with several blossoms, but only a few tiny developing fruits. The scene shows reduced fruit development rather than a completely dead tree. Rich green leaves and soft sunlight surround the branch.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show reduced pollination success, not total plant death.

beats.narration_text: सेब, बादाम और कई दूसरी फसलों पर इसका असर पड़ सकता है।
beats.prompt_action: Overhead composition of a wooden harvest table displaying apples, almonds, berries and other produce. Some baskets are full while others contain visibly fewer fruits, creating a visual comparison of a disrupted harvest. No writing or labels.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Use recognizable fruits and nuts to communicate which foods may be affected.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन इसका मतलब ये नहीं कि हर फसल खत्म हो जाएगी।
beats.prompt_action: Wide cinematic view of a healthy wheat field waving in the wind under a bright blue sky. Golden wheat stalks release fine pollen into the breeze. The field remains healthy and productive without any insects.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Introduce wind pollination as an important exception.

beats.narration_text: गेहूँ जैसी कई फसलें हवा से ही परागित हो जाती हैं।
beats.prompt_action: Macro side view of golden wheat stalks swaying as tiny pollen particles drift through the air from one flower structure to another. A sunlit field stretches into a softly painted background. Emphasize wind-driven pollination.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep the wheat field healthy and insect-free.

beats.narration_text: यानी कुछ खाना बचेगा, लेकिन हमारी खाने की दुनिया बदलने लगेगी।
beats.prompt_action: Aarav stands beside a garden table holding an apple in one hand and a small bunch of wheat stalks in the other. He looks thoughtful, comparing two different food sources. His mustard-yellow overshirt, cream T-shirt, navy trousers, white sneakers and rounded two-dot-eye face remain unchanged.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show Aarav understanding that some foods remain while others become less reliable.

beats.narration_text: और सबसे बड़ा झटका सिर्फ इंसानों को नहीं लगेगा।
beats.prompt_action: Cinematic aerial view over a dense green forest with a layered canopy, a winding stream and patches of sunlight. The forest appears beautiful but strangely silent, with no insects anywhere.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Transition from the garden to a large insect-free forest ecosystem.

beats.narration_text: कई पक्षियों का खाना ही छोटे कीड़े होते हैं।
beats.prompt_action: A small warm-brown forest bird with a cream belly, short pointed beak, two wings, two legs and tiny black dot eyes searches anxiously among green leaves and branches. No insects are visible. The forest background is detailed and softly illuminated.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep the bird's warm-brown and cream coloring consistent.

beats.narration_text: अब उसे खाना ढूँढने के लिए और दूर जाना पड़ेगा।
beats.prompt_action: Dynamic side view of the same small brown-and-cream bird flying between tall forest trees, searching across branches and foliage. Its wings are spread in motion, and the forest floor below is empty of insects.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the bird searching harder for food.

beats.narration_text: मेंढक और छिपकलियों के लिए भी खाना कम हो जाएगा।
beats.prompt_action: A small bright-green frog with a rounded body, four natural limbs and tiny black dot pupils sits on a moss-covered rock, staring at an empty patch of forest floor where insects would normally appear. A distant lizard searches among leaves.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show insect-eating animals facing food shortages without depicting injury.

beats.narration_text: फिर असर उन जानवरों तक भी पहुँचेगा जो इन्हें खाते हैं।
beats.prompt_action: A layered forest composition showing a small bird on a branch, a frog on a mossy rock and a larger owl perched higher in the tree. The visual arrangement suggests a connected food web. The forest is lush but completely insect-free.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Communicate that food shortages can spread through multiple levels of the food web.

beats.narration_text: यानी एक छोटा सा बदलाव पूरे जंगल की ज़िंदगी हिला सकता है।
beats.prompt_action: Top-down cinematic view of a forest clearing showing a bird searching near a tree root, a frog beside a small puddle and a lizard among fallen leaves. Their separate movements are connected by subtle natural visual pathways. No insects are present.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the interconnected forest ecosystem and its dependence on insects.

beats.narration_text: और एक और काम है जो ये छोटे जीव चुपचाप करते हैं।
beats.prompt_action: Ground-level macro view of fallen autumn leaves covering rich forest soil. The leaf litter is detailed with tiny twigs, damp earth and patches of moss. No insects are visible, and the camera draws attention to the forest floor.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Introduce decomposition and nutrient recycling.

beats.narration_text: गिरे हुए पत्तों और मरे पौधों को तोड़कर मिट्टी तक पोषण पहुँचाना।
beats.prompt_action: Extreme macro cross-section of forest soil showing decaying leaves, small mushrooms, fine fungal threads and microscopic bacteria represented as tiny soft glowing shapes. No insects or insect larvae are visible. Rich earthy textures and detailed natural illustration.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show fungi and bacteria continuing decomposition in the absence of insects.

beats.narration_text: कीड़ों के बिना ये प्रक्रिया धीमी और अलग हो सकती है, लेकिन रुकेगी नहीं।
beats.prompt_action: Scientific storybook cutaway of forest soil with a layer of fallen leaves slowly breaking down through fungal threads and microscopic bacteria. The upper forest remains green, while the underground layers show the ongoing natural recycling process.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Make clear that decomposition continues through other organisms, although the process changes.

beats.narration_text: अब सोचो, इसका असर किसान की ज़िंदगी पर कितना बड़ा होगा।
beats.prompt_action: Wide cinematic view of an Indian farmer standing in a large agricultural field with flowering fruit trees, crop rows and distant hills. The middle-aged farmer has a warm-brown rounded face, exactly two tiny black dot eyes, short black hair, light beige shirt, forest-green trousers, brown sandals and an off-white cotton headscarf.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Introduce the farmer with consistent clothing and complete cartoon anatomy.

beats.narration_text: कई फलों और सब्ज़ियों की पैदावार घट सकती है।
beats.prompt_action: Over-the-shoulder view of the same Indian farmer examining a fruit tree branch with many blossoms but fewer developing fruits. His hand gently touches a small fruit. The farm looks healthy overall but the harvest appears uneven.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show a realistic reduction in some crops rather than total agricultural collapse.

beats.narration_text: कुछ किसान हाथों से भी पराग पहुँचाने की कोशिश कर सकते हैं।
beats.prompt_action: Close-up of the same farmer carefully using a small soft brush to transfer pollen between flowers on a fruit tree. His beige sleeve and hand are clearly visible, with delicate yellow pollen on the brush. The background is a sunlit orchard.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show manual pollination as a possible limited human response.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन इतने सारे पौधों के लिए ये करना आसान नहीं होगा।
beats.prompt_action: High-angle view of a vast orchard stretching across the landscape. The farmer appears small, manually pollinating only one nearby branch while thousands of other flowers extend into the distance. The composition communicates the enormous scale of the task.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Emphasize that manual pollination cannot easily replace natural pollination at large scale.

beats.narration_text: धीरे-धीरे बाज़ार में भी कुछ चीज़ें कम दिखने लगेंगी।
beats.prompt_action: Wide view of a lively Indian vegetable market with colorful stalls. Some baskets of apples, berries and other fruits are noticeably smaller, while potatoes, wheat and other produce remain available. Shoppers browse the market with concerned expressions.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Transition to the market and show uneven availability rather than empty shelves.

beats.narration_text: कुछ खाने की चीज़ें महँगी भी हो सकती हैं।
beats.prompt_action: Close-up of a market vendor arranging a small basket of apples and berries beside fuller baskets of potatoes and wheat. A shopper compares the available produce with a concerned expression. No readable price tags or text.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show possible changes in food availability and prices without making numerical claims.

beats.narration_text: हालाँकि कुछ नुकसान भी कम होंगे, जैसे कई फसल खाने वाले कीट भी गायब हो जाएँगे।
beats.prompt_action: A healthy green crop leaf with no visible chewing damage, surrounded by vibrant healthy plants in a sunlit field. The scene visually suggests that some crop-damaging insect pests have also disappeared, without showing any insects.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Introduce the nuance that the disappearance of some harmful insect pests could reduce certain types of crop damage.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन फायदा कुछ जगह होगा, और नुकसान कई पूरे पारिस्थितिक तंत्रों में।
beats.prompt_action: Cinematic split composition: on one side, healthy undamaged crop leaves in a farm; on the other, a quiet forest with a bird searching for food and a frog sitting on moss. Both environments are rich and detailed, emphasizing the trade-off between reduced crop pests and wider ecological disruption.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Balance the story by showing both potential benefits and much larger ecosystem consequences.

beats.narration_text: और सबसे डरावनी बात ये है कि हमें इसका पूरा असर तुरंत दिखाई भी नहीं देगा।
beats.prompt_action: Aarav sits at a wooden dining table in a cozy Indian kitchen, looking at a plate of food containing wheat bread, vegetables and fruit. His warm-white rounded face, two tiny black dot eyes, short neat black hair, mustard-yellow overshirt, cream T-shirt, navy trousers and white sneakers are identical to earlier scenes.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Bring Aarav back into the story and maintain his exact design.

beats.narration_text: कुछ असर मौसमों और सालों के साथ सामने आएँगे।
beats.prompt_action: A single fruit orchard shown as a cinematic seasonal progression from spring blossoms to summer fruit growth and autumn harvest. Some branches produce fewer fruits while others remain productive. Use a visually clear progression with warm changing seasonal light.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Communicate gradual long-term consequences rather than instant global collapse.

beats.narration_text: क्योंकि कीड़े सिर्फ परेशान करने वाले जीव नहीं हैं।
beats.prompt_action: Beautiful close-up of a bright-red ladybug with a rounded shell, distinct black spots, six tiny black legs and tiny black dot eyes resting on a fresh green leaf. Warm sunlight highlights the leaf texture. This is a present-day illustrative memory of the insect before the hypothetical disappearance.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Reintroduce the ladybug only as a visual memory of the world before the hypothetical event.

beats.narration_text: ये खेती, जंगल और खाने की पूरी व्यवस्था का हिस्सा हैं।
beats.prompt_action: Grand aerial cinematic illustration connecting a flower garden, agricultural farmland, a green forest and a flowing river into one expansive landscape. Birds, plants and animals appear as small details. The composition suggests that every part of nature is connected.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the interconnectedness of natural ecosystems in one coherent landscape.

beats.narration_text: तो अगली बार कोई छोटी सी मधुमक्खी दिखे, उसे सिर्फ भगाना मत।
beats.prompt_action: Aarav stands in a sunlit garden and calmly watches a golden-yellow honeybee hovering near a flower from a safe distance. He smiles gently without touching or disturbing it. His complete cartoon anatomy and exact mustard-yellow overshirt, cream T-shirt, navy trousers and white sneakers remain consistent.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Return to the present-day world where insects still exist and show respectful observation from a safe distance.

beats.narration_text: क्योंकि जिस छोटे जीव को हम नज़रअंदाज़ करते हैं, वही हमारी दुनिया को चलाने में मदद करता है।
beats.prompt_action: Low-angle cinematic shot of a tiny golden-yellow honeybee hovering above a vibrant flower, with a vast green garden and sunlit sky behind it. The bee appears small in the foreground while the natural world fills the frame, creating a powerful visual contrast.
beats.session_delta_prompt: End with the importance of a tiny insect in a much larger ecosystem.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन सोचो, अगर अगले पाँच सेकंड में ये सारे कीड़े सच में गायब हो जाएँ तो?
beats.prompt_action: Extreme close-up of the same golden-yellow honeybee hovering beside the same vibrant purple flower from the opening shot. Its translucent wings are frozen mid-flight, pollen glows in the sunlight, and the background is softly blurred. Match the opening composition precisely so the video loops seamlessly.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Recreate the exact opening image composition with the same honeybee, purple flower, lighting and camera angle to create a seamless loop.
